svg.title: Stack, as a periodic table
svg.desc: My stack as a periodic table of 64 elements. LANGUAGES: Go 1.26, C17 · clang, C++17 · MSVC, C# · .NET 4.8, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java; MORE LANGUAGES: PowerShell, GLSL, WebAssembly, SQL, POSIX sh, GDScript, HTML, CSS; GRAPHICS: Direct2D, DirectWrite, WIC, WebGL2, three.js, FreeType, HarfBuzz, SIMD · SSE2/AVX2; WINDOWS: Win32, NT native API, COM, DWM, WebView2, GDI · GDI+, Service Control, Named pipes; SYSTEMS: Docker Engine API, WSL, TCP · UDP tables, http.sys, HTTP/1.1, Server-Sent Events, Job Objects, UAC; WEB & MOBILE: Node.js, Vite, Web Audio, AudioWorklet, Web Workers, PWA, DevTools Protocol, Android; FORMATS: PNG · APNG, WebP, AVIF · HEIF, PDF, QR code, GIF, DEFLATE, EXR · HDR; TOOLS & AI: Git, GitHub Actions, MSVC, clang · LLD, Zig cc, AddressSanitizer, ffmpeg, llama.cpp. 20 symbols are also real chemical elements: C, Ts, Gd, Cs, Th, Si, W, Co, Sc, Np, Tc, Hs, Se, No, Au, Cd, Pd, Ga, Cl, As.
svg.text: the symbol is also a real chemical element — 20 of 64
